_note: Attach these attributes to every LLM span. gen_ai.* names follow the OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions (status: Development; older libraries use gen_ai.system instead of gen_ai.provider.name). app.* names are project-defined. trace_id comes from the OpenTelemetry context; model_version maps to gen_ai.response.model. app.tenant_id is an ID, never a name or email.
